Before swapping, _buyOLAS() enforces slippage protection through IOracle(poolOracle).validatePrice(maxSlippage). However, UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice() does not compute a TWAP. It reads cumulativePriceLast and blockTimestampLast from the pair, then sets tradePrice = getPrice(), computes cumulativePrice = cumulativePriceLast + tradePrice * elapsedTime, and finally computes timeWeightedAverage = (cumulativePrice - cumulativePriceLast) / elapsedTime (validatePrice()). This algebraically forces timeWeightedAverage == tradePrice whenever elapsedTime > 0, which makes derivation == 0 and causes validatePrice() to accept any spot price.
